pr_title: Add EnumBuilder.CreateType back in the public API
pr_body:
Fix #46681

I also sync'd the ref source with the implementation w.r.t. override members. This makes it easier going forward for people using GenerateReferenceAssemblySource to generate this file. Less manual fix ups.
pr_comments:
Note regarding the `new-api-needs-documentation` label:

This serves as a reminder for when your PR is modifying a ref *.cs file and adding/modifying public APIs, to please make sure the API implementation in the src *.cs file is documented with triple slash comments, so the PR reviewers can sign off that change.

@carlossanlop - since this API already existed in .NET Framework, we have MSDN docs for it:

https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.reflection.emit.enumbuilder.createtype

This API also already exists in the implementation assembly. I'm just exposing the `ref` for it.

Will that documentation automatically get backported to the `src` file?

review_comments: Was this moved due to sorting?

Correct. All the properties go first, in alphabetical order. Then methods.

The [GenerateReferenceAssemblySource](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/coding-guidelines/updating-ref-source.md) tool puts them in that order. I took the liberty of fixing the simple diffs here, which means less manual work for the next person who wants to update the ref source.
So these and others are no longer overridden in the implementation?

Correct. I verified with @safern that it isn't critical that the `ref` and `src` assemblies match on overrides. But since the GenerateReferenceAssemblySource tool was generating different code, I decided to check these in so the next person didn't have to fight with them.
